title: Broadband Mid-Wave Infrared Imaging Enabled by All-Silicon Hyperboloid Metalens
abstract: arXiv:2610.29841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The mid-wave infrared (MWIR, 3-5 microns) is indispensable for thermal sensing, gas detection, long-range imaging, and free-space optical communications. Meta-optics offer a compact, lightweight, and potentially low-cost alternative to conventional refractive optics, making them attractive for size, weight, and power (SWaP)-constrained systems. However, their strong chromatic dispersion has largely restricted imaging to narrow spectral bands. Here, we demonstrate broadband imaging across the full 3-5 micron MWIR band using a single-layer silicon metasurface coupled with computational reconstruction. Remarkably, the reconstruction model is adapted using only four image captures, overcoming large training data requirements and enabling broadband image recovery despite the strongly wavelength-dependent optical response. translated_title: 全硅双曲面超透镜实现的中波红外宽带成像
translated_abstract: 中波红外（MWIR，3-5微米）波段对于热传感、气体检测、远距离成像和自由空间光通信而言不可或缺。超构光学为传统折射光学提供了一种紧凑、轻量且潜在低成本的替代方案，对受尺寸、重量和功耗（SWaP）限制的系统极具吸引力。然而，其强烈的色散在很大程度上将成像限制在窄光谱波段。在此，我们展示了利用单层硅超构表面结合计算重构，在整个3-5微米中波红外波段实现宽带成像。值得注意的是，该重构模型仅需四次图像采集即可完成适配，克服了对大量训练数据的需求，并在光学响应强烈依赖于波长的情况下实现了宽带图像恢复。与那些为宽带工作而设计复杂色散优化超透镜结构的方法不同，我们的……
tldr: 该论文利用单层全硅双曲面超透镜结合仅需四次图像采集即可适配的计算重构模型，克服了超透镜的强色散限制，实现了覆盖整个3-5微米中波红外波段的宽带成像。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates broadband imaging across the full 3-5 μm mid-wave infrared band using a single-layer all-silicon hyperboloid metalens coupled with a reconstruction model adapted from only four image captures, overcoming strong chromatic dispersion without requiring complex dispersion-optimized metalens designs or large training datasets.
